title: Known limitations
note: Headings are read from the documents at build time, never retyped, so an entry that is resolved there cannot stay open here.

entries.title: Flat confidence under duplication depends on training-time adaptation
Residual per-pair dependence accumulates with view count
The discount addresses redundant evidence, not unreliable evidence
The discount is proportional, not capping, and weakens as evidence grows
The suspicion detector inherits the dependence signal's blind spot, and inverts under missing evidence
The shared/private objective does not fix which branch carries cross-view information, and ENIV reads only one of them
Tail dependence is not the sharper instrument the argument predicted; it inverts under strong attack
Detection and correction fail together, because both read cross-view belief agreement
ENIV is validated only on synthetic data, where rho is a parameter we set
Dependence is estimated from finite batches, and the estimator is biased
Tail dependence is unreliable below 50 exceedances, and the threshold bites
The attacker capabilities that defeat the defence are specific, and only partly tested
V1 detaches the discount, so it corrects inference but never shapes representation
One dataset family, and five seeds that are five partitions of it
No human-subject evaluation and no deployment evaluation were run

group_labels.standing: standing limitations of the project as a whole

entries.title: Retrieval coverage: one angle of five contributes
GitHub returned 0 records because the query was an 8-12 term conjunction
The arXiv query was query-independent because the connector was sent raw prose
Financial is structurally incompatible with the dataset, by design conflict
The free Groq tier cannot fund a 5-seed evaluation
Consequence: ECE and Brier cannot yet be computed
NEW, created by the V2-L2 fix: some GitHub records exceed the whole token budget
